description: This file defines the Cobalt extension API for a demuxer, including enums, structs, and function pointers for media demuxing operations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the demuxer; must be called once.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified time in microseconds.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the media in microseconds since Windows epoch.

methods.name: GetTimelineOffset
methods.description: Returns the timeline offset in microseconds since Windows epoch.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads media data of a specified stream type using a callback.

methods.name: GetAudioConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the audio decoder configuration if available.

methods.name: GetVideoConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the video decoder configuration if available.

methods.name: GetDuration
methods.description: Returns the total duration of the media in microseconds.
